novelty.justification: The claim proposes a new phenomenon and mechanism: "more fragmented numerals lead a reasoning model to think longer on the exact same problem" because fragmentation "inflates an internal difficulty/length signal read before reasoning begins," with that signal causally governing the thinking budget. Searches for "numeral tokenization reasoning length," "tokenizer fragmentation chain-of-thought overthinking," "numeric formatting inference-time compute," and "activation patching reasoning budget" found adjacent work—Teaching Arithmetic to Small Transformers on formatting and arithmetic accuracy, DAST on difficulty-adaptive token budgets, and Steering LLM Thinking with Budget Guidance—but none links matched numeral segmentation to wasted reasoning tokens through a fragmentation-sensitive boundary representation. Moving from those works to the claimed segmentation-to-budget causal relationship requires a new core relationship rather than a direct transfer, although it remains within established tokenizer, overthinking, and activation-patching frameworks rather than creating a new paradigm.
